svg.title: What the Activity stream shows
svg.desc: A run, scheduled or by hand, that changed something adds one entry for the target user, with the counts of its changes and links to its first five files and to the archive folder. Every file of the inbox that Paperless imported adds an entry with a link to its new document in Paperless, every file that Paperless failed to import one with the reason and a link to the file in the error folder, and every file that Paperless refused one with the reason, as the file stays in the inbox. A dry-run and a run without changes add none.
